verdict.rationale: Extract has a documented example for pulling structured data from SEC filings "with citations" so values can be verified against the source document. Parse separately offers table extraction with source-page provenance and enriched forms output that includes bounding boxes. These pieces are scattered across example pages, though, with no evidence that every extracted field consistently carries page, bbox and snippet together. missing for 10: explicit per-field provenance schema in Extract (page number + bounding box + source snippet on every field), reference docs describing the citation output format, independent or hands-on corroboration.
